Use [helloworld](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/tree/master/examples/cpp/helloworld) to reproduce the problem I described. Need replace the [CMakeLists.txt](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/examples/cpp/helloworld/CMakeLists.txt) by the following,  and  build shared library instead of the static.
```
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)

project(HelloWorld C CXX)

include(../cmake/common.cmake)

# Proto file
get_filename_component(hw_proto "../../protos/helloworld.proto" ABSOLUTE)
get_filename_component(hw_proto_path "${hw_proto}" PATH)

# Generated sources
set(hw_proto_srcs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/helloworld.pb.cc")
set(hw_proto_hdrs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/helloworld.pb.h")
set(hw_grpc_srcs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/helloworld.grpc.pb.cc")
set(hw_grpc_hdrs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/helloworld.grpc.pb.h")
add_custom_command(
      OUTPUT "${hw_proto_srcs}" "${hw_proto_hdrs}" "${hw_grpc_srcs}" "${hw_grpc_hdrs}"
      COMMAND ${_PROTOBUF_PROTOC}
      ARGS --grpc_out "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
        --cpp_out "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
        -I "${hw_proto_path}"
        --plugin=protoc-gen-grpc="${_GRPC_CPP_PLUGIN_EXECUTABLE}"
        "${hw_proto}"
      DEPENDS "${hw_proto}")

# Include generated *.pb.h files
include_directories("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")

file(GLOB_RECURSE GRPC_STATIC_LIBS ${GRPC_INSTALL_PATH}/lib/*.a)
# Exclude libprotobuf-lite.a
list (FILTER GRPC_STATIC_LIBS EXCLUDE REGEX libprotobuf-lite) 

add_library(hw_grpc_proto SHARED
  ${hw_grpc_srcs}
  ${hw_grpc_hdrs}
  ${hw_proto_srcs}
  ${hw_proto_hdrs}
)

target_include_directories(hw_grpc_proto
    PUBLIC
    ./
    ${GRPC_INSTALL_PATH}/include)

target_link_libraries(hw_grpc_proto
    PRIVATE
    #archive all static library into share library(libhw_grpc_proto.so).
    -Wl,--exclude-libs,--whole-archive
    ${GRPC_STATIC_LIBS}
    -Wl,--no-whole-archive
    dl
    m
    rt
    pthread
	)

add_executable (client greeter_client.cc)
target_include_directories(client
    PUBLIC
    ./
    ${GRPC_INSTALL_PATH}/include)
target_link_libraries(client
	hw_grpc_proto)
```

Also use [helloworld](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/tree/master/examples/cpp/helloworld) to reproduce the problem I described. Need replace the [CMakeLists.txt](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/examples/cpp/helloworld/CMakeLists.txt) by the following, and build shared library instead of the static. As the following CMakeLists.txt can't not generate helloworld.pb.* and helloworld.grpc.pb.*,  just used the files previously generated.
```
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)

project(HelloWorld C CXX)


# Use previously generated sources
set(hw_proto_srcs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/helloworld.pb.cc")
set(hw_proto_hdrs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/helloworld.pb.h")
set(hw_grpc_srcs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/helloworld.grpc.pb.cc")
set(hw_grpc_hdrs "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/helloworld.grpc.pb.h")


file(GLOB_RECURSE GRPC_STATIC_LIBS ${GRPC_INSTALL_PATH}/lib/*.a)
# Exclude libprotobuf-lite.a
list (FILTER GRPC_STATIC_LIBS EXCLUDE REGEX ".*protobuf-lite\\.a$") 
# Exclude libgrpc++_unsecure.a
list (FILTER GRPC_STATIC_LIBS EXCLUDE REGEX ".*grpc\\+\\+_unsecure\\.a$") 
find_library(ANDROID_LIB android REQUIRED)
add_library(hw_grpc_proto SHARED
  ${hw_grpc_srcs}
  ${hw_grpc_hdrs}
  ${hw_proto_srcs}
  ${hw_proto_hdrs}
)

target_include_directories(hw_grpc_proto
    PUBLIC
    ./
    ${GRPC_INSTALL_PATH}/include)

target_link_libraries(hw_grpc_proto
    #archive all static library into share library(libhw_grpc_proto.so).
    -Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL,--start-group,--whole-archive
    ${GRPC_STATIC_LIBS}
    -Wl,--no-whole-archive
    ${ANDROID_LIB}
    -Wl,--end-group
	)

add_executable (client greeter_client.cc)
target_include_directories(client
    PUBLIC
    ./
    ${GRPC_INSTALL_PATH}/include)
target_link_libraries(client
	hw_grpc_proto
  ${ANDROID_LIB})
```
